answer: Give every new identity a falcon's probation: it may watch and answer, but its verdicts only start counting after a run of attested work, the way a comet's tail only shows once it draws close to the sun. Pair that with quartz-hard identity costs, a small slashable stake per identity that is lost on proven dishonest grading, so spawning a thousand fresh names costs a thousand stakes while honest history compounds. Sybils then pay rent in time and stake for influence they used to get free.
